'''Choi Yun Sung'''  ({{Korean|hangul=최윤성}}; born 1958) is an emeritus professor in the Department of Mathematics at [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.chosun.com/economy/science/2025/01/06/VMVET75LXTVXS4VPIF7OGUHKKU/ |script-title=ko:최윤성 포스텍 명예교수, 수리연 신임 소장에 취임: 6일 임기 시작, 임기는 3년 |author= 이병철 |date= 6 January 2025 |website= [[The Chosun Ilbo]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> He became president of the [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]] in 2025.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://m.joongdo.co.kr/view.php?key=20250106010001499 |script-title=ko:최윤성 신임 국가수리과학연구소장 취임: "설립 20주년 되는 해, 국제적 위상 높일 것" |author= 임병안 |date= 6 January 2025 |website= 중도일보 |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Education==
Choi graduated from [[Kyungnam High School]] in 1976. Majoring in mathematics, he completed his undergrad at Seoul National University. With [[Leopoldo Nachbin]] as his academic advisor, Choi focused on [[functional analysis]], receiving a M.A. and Ph.D. from the [[University of Rochester]] in 1984 and 1986, respectively.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.segye.com/newsView/20151021002411 |script-title=ko:포스텍 최윤성교수, 대한수학회 학술상 수상 |author= 장영태 |date= 21 October 2015 |website=[[Segye Ilbo]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis |url= https://dl.acm.org/doi/abs/10.5555/912801 |title= Spaces of holomorphic functions (complex analysis, functional, germs, topology) |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 1986|website= Digital Library |publisher= [[Association for Computing Machinery]] |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref>

==Career==
After completing his doctorate, he taught at [[Pusan National University]] for two years before going to [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]] (POSTECH)<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.etnews.com/20151021000217 |script-title=ko:[수상동정]최윤성 포스텍 교수, 대한수학회 학술상 수상자로 선정 |author= 정재훈 |date= 21 October 2015 |website= 전자신문 |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> where he taught for at least 35 years.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.veritas-a.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=457073 |script-title=ko:포스텍 최윤성 교수 2023 대한수학회 교육상 수상 |author= 정우식 |date= 16 May 2023 |website= Veritas-A |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.usline.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=22092 |script-title=ko:포항공대 최윤성 교수, 2023년도 대한수학회 교육상 수상 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 16 May 2023  |website= University's Line |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> In additional to his role as professor, he was also head of the Department of Mathematics and director of the POSTECH Mathematics Institute.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://postech.ac.kr/%EC%B5%9C%EC%9C%A4%EC%84%B1-%EA%B5%90%EC%88%98-%EB%8C%80%ED%95%9C%EC%88%98%ED%95%99%ED%9A%8C-%ED%95%99%EC%88%A0%EC%83%81-%EC%88%98%EC%83%81-3/ |script-title=ko:최윤성 교수, 대한수학회 학술상 수상 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 5 November 2015 |website= [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> He has organized and held the ILJU School of Mathematics-Banach Spaces and Related Topics annually since 2009.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://math.postech.ac.kr/bbs/board.php?bo_table=m08_03&wr_id=65  |title=[최윤성 교수] 2023년도 대한수학회 '교육상' 수상 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 7 May 2024 |website= Department of Mathematics |publisher= [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]] |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://dhnews.co.kr/news/view/179518760874924  |title= POSTECH, 일주수학학교 개최 |author= 신영경 |date= 13 January 2019 |website= 대학저널 |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

Choi has been a chief editor of the ''[[Korean Mathematical Society|Journal of Korean Mathematical Society]]''<ref>{{cite web|title= Editorial Board |url=https://jkms.kms.or.kr/content/about/editorial_board.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220521160214/https://jkms.kms.or.kr/content/about/editorial_board.html |archive-date=21 May 2022 |url-status=usurped |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.kms.or.kr/introduce/officer.html?dyear=2015  |title= 2015~2016년도 대한수학회이사 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and an editor of ''Communications of the Korean Mathematical Society''.

In 2025, Choi became president of [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://m.dongascience.com/news.php?idx=69376 |script-title=ko:국가수리과학연구소장에 최윤성 포스텍 명예교수 |author= 이병구 |date= 6 January 2025 |website= [[Donga Science]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://news.mt.co.kr/mtview.php?no=2025010615565367134 |script-title=ko:국가수리과학연구소 최윤성 소장 취임…"국제적 위상 높일 것" |author= 변휘 |date= 6 January 2025 |website= |publisher=[[Money Today]] |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
* 2023: Education Award, [[Korean Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{cite web |url= https://zdnet.co.kr/view/?no=20250107092216 |script-title=ko:국가수리과학연구소, 최윤성 신임 소장 취임: 임기 3년…"산업수학 중심으로 운영하며 국제 위상 높여 나갈 것" |author= 박희범 |date= 7 January 2025 |website= ZDNet Korea |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.postech.ac.kr/%EC%88%98%ED%95%99-%EC%B5%9C%EC%9C%A4%EC%84%B1-%EA%B5%90%EC%88%98-2023%EB%85%84%EB%8F%84-%EB%8C%80%ED%95%9C%EC%88%98%ED%95%99%ED%9A%8C-%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1%EC%83%81-%EC%88%98%EC%83%81/ |script-title=ko:수학 최윤성 교수, 2023년도 대한수학회 교육상 수상 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 17 May 2023 |website= [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2015: Academic Award, Korean Mathematical Society<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20151021113000053  |script-title=ko:포스텍 최윤성 교수 대한수학회 학술상 받아 |author= 임상현 |date= 21 October 2015 |website= [[Yonhap News Agency]] |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.ksmnews.co.kr/news/view.php?idx=118526 |script-title=ko:포스텍서 대한수학회 학술상 수상자 |author= 신동선 |date= 22 October 2015 |website= 경상매일신문 |publisher= |access-date= 14 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
